author: lapa6925
content:
Hi team!

Could you please share your latest roadmap and the main developments planned for the next 12 months?

I’m particularly interested in your key priorities, upcoming milestones, major updates, and any planned partnerships or significant changes to the project or its tokenomics. Where possible, please include expected dates or quarters and distinguish confirmed plans from proposals still under discussion.

Please also share all relevant official links where I can follow these plans and track their progress—especially your roadmap, along with announcements, posts, documentation, development updates, and official channels or community discussions.

If there is no public roadmap, could you point me to the most recent materials outlining your plans and upcoming milestones?

Thank you!
